messages:
anya: thinking about adding a /deploy --sampler command that runs N smoke requests against the canary and annotates the rollout with pass/fail hooks.
leo: +1. would that run before traffic shift or in-parallel?
sam: before shifting traffic ideally, quick HTTP checks to key endpoints and a small openai-style prompt to validate semantic responses.
mira: also want an automatic note in release notes that includes sampler outcome and sample logs. saves manual checking.
leo: proto syntax?
anya: ```
/deploy start v2.4.3 --canary=10 --sampler=5 --sampler-timeout=8s --on-fail=hold
``` 
anya: this would kick off deploy-bot which runs 5 parallel sample requests against canary and posts results.
deploy-bot: Received command: start v2.4.3; canary=10; sampler=5; sampler-timeout=8s; on-fail=hold
sam: ops question: where do we store sample queries? repo? or a prompt-set in console?
leo: store canonical sampler set in repo under release/samplers/<service>.json and allow overrides via --sampler-file.
mira: for change windows, default sampler runs only in change-window unless --force used.
anya: decision: default sampler=3, max allowed without approval=10. for >10 require approver role.
sam: noted. i'll add a small python wrapper that calls the bot REST endpoint and uploads sampler logs to s3.
leo: can we annotate the release notes auto-template with summary line: "Sampler: 5/5 passed (details: link)" ?
anya: yes — add tokenized field sampler_result -> included by release-note-generator.
mira: action items: sam implement wrapper (ETA tomorrow), leo add repo sampler schema PR, anya add bot flag checks & approval flow.
anya: tagging @oncall so they know the hold behavior: if sampler fails we hold and page @oncall.
leo: :thumbsup:
sam: :raised_hands:
